memory_candidates.content: When a jq function returns an array (e.g., def pdf_candidates(entry): [...];), do NOT wrap the call in another array constructor in the output object. Writing `pdf_paths: [pdf_candidates(.)]` produces a nested array [[v1,v2]] rather than a flat array [v1,v2]. Use `pdf_paths: pdf_candidates(.)` directly.

Bash heredoc show_usage() pattern: use a fixed heredoc rather than sed ranges over the script header to avoid duplicate output caused by overlapping sed range patterns. Write the usage text explicitly in the heredoc inside show_usage(). Accept an optional fd argument (default 2) so --help can redirect to stdout (fd 1) while error usage goes to stderr (fd 2).
